Walk to the garage, talk to the mechanic, get the sedan keys, and get inside the car.
Walk to the repair garage and talk to Marco.
Get into the parked sedan outside the garage.
Morning! Good timing — the sedan is tuned and fueled up.
Here are the keys. North Cargo Depot just called about an urgent spare-parts crate.
Hop in the sedan. Take Cumhuriyet Avenue or cut through Cinar Street.
Deliver the spare parts to the North Cargo Depot before time runs out.
Drive to the North Cargo Depot delivery bay before the timer expires.
Step out and speak with Elena at the cargo depot.
You made it before the shift cutoff. Drop the crate right here — thanks.
Wait a second before you leave. One of our cargo sedans never checked back in today.
Last anyone saw it, a dark sedan was parked in the west residential quarter. Could you search for it on foot?
Search the neighborhood on foot for the described car and find the next shipment address.
Head into the west residential quarter and locate the missing dark sedan.
Inspect the missing car on foot to find the next shipment address.
Plate matches — this is Elena's missing cargo sedan. The driver's door was left unlatched.
There's a manifest slip in the glovebox: 'Courier leaving the depot will drop the package on the west street.'
If I head back to the depot exit now, I can tail that courier car to the drop point.
Follow the car leaving the depot without losing sight or getting too close, then collect the dropped package.
Drive to the lookout point outside the North Cargo Depot exit.
Follow the courier car without losing sight or getting too close (12m – 75m).
Collect the dropped package on foot where the courier stopped.
Got the sealed package. It holds the original depot manifests and garage invoices.
Marco wants this brought back to the repair garage, while Elena is waiting at the town square.
Return to town via either route and deliver the package to Marco or Elena.
Return to the town center via Cumhuriyet Avenue or Cinar Street.
Deliver the package to Marco at the garage OR to Elena waiting at the town square.
I knew depot dispatch was behind the mix-up. Bringing the package to me was the smart move.
With these records, nobody can pin the missing parts on our shop. Here's your cut (+₺ 300).
Shift's over, kid. Keep the sedan keys and roam the town however you like!
I hoped you'd bring the package straight to me! The missing manifest logs are all right here.
I cleared your bonus with depot operations (+₺ 300). You saved the entire shift.
You're off the clock now — explore Cinarli Town freely or pick up side jobs whenever you want!
Good day, dear. On Selman Street everybody knows everybody.
Wanna play football? There's a match at the Gürsu Street pitch!
We're the on-duty pharmacy this week. Get well soon!
Our door is always open to every neighbor.
Bring Auntie Ayşe's groceries from Hüseyin's corner shop.
Talk to Auntie Ayşe on the south sidewalk.
Pick up the grocery bag in front of Selman Market.
Deliver the bag to Auntie Ayşe in time.
My knees are aching, dear, I couldn't walk to the shop.
Hüseyin packed my order, it's by his door. Would you bring it?
Bread, milk, a pack of tea… Auntie Ayşe's order is complete.
Bless you, child! I'll brew some tea for you.
Take this pocket money, don't you refuse it (+300 ₺).
Find Little Efe's white cat Pamuk somewhere in the neighborhood.
Talk to Little Efe, who is crying.
Check the football pitch on Gürsu Street.
Inspect the collar lying on the pitch.
Find Pamuk in the Hz. Osman Mosque courtyard and pick her up.
Bring Pamuk back to Little Efe.
Pamuk is gone! She was following us while we played football…
Can you check the pitch? I'm really scared.
Pamuk's blue collar! There's a fish bone stuck on it…
People feed cats in the mosque courtyard. She must be there.
There she is! Pamuk jumps into your arms, purring.
PAMUK! Thank you, you're a hero!
Mom told me to give you this (+350 ₺).
Get the medicine for Auntie Ayşe's husband from the pharmacy in time.
Talk to a worried Auntie Ayşe.
Get in your car right away.
Drive to the on-duty pharmacy in the east before time runs out.
Get the medicine from Pharmacist Selin.
Rush the medicine back to Auntie Ayşe.
Uncle Hasan ran out of his blood pressure pills, he's dizzy!
The pharmacy is at the east end of the street. Take your car!
Mr. Hasan's prescription is ready. One a day, after meals.
Hurry, don't be late. Get well wishes!
You made it! Uncle Hasan took his pill, he's feeling better.
Bring Marco's spare part, left at the gas station, back to the garage.
Talk to Marco at the repair garage.
Drive to the gas station in the west.
Get out and pick up the spare part box.
Drive the part back to the garage before the customer leaves.
The courier dropped my part at the gas station, and the customer is waiting!
Take the car, grab the box and come right back. I trust you.
A timing belt kit — the box says 'Auto Repair No:73'.
Right on time! The customer's car will be ready by noon.
Here's your pay (+450 ₺). I also checked your car.
Help Elena prepare the street festival and tell Mukhtar Remzi.
Talk to Elena in front of No:66.
Pick up the tea box in front of the Tea House.
Pick up the simit tray next to the market.
Go to the festival area (Gürsu St. football pitch).
Tell Mukhtar Remzi the festival is ready.
The festival is tonight and the tea and simit still haven't arrived!
Could you grab the tea from the Tea House and the simit by the market, then bring them to the pitch?
A huge box of Rize tea. The samovars won't run dry tonight.
Warm sesame simits… they smell amazing.
Wonderful! Tea and simit are here, the festival can begin.
The whole neighborhood is talking about you. This reward is from all of us (+1000 ₺).
Chapter 1 complete! New streets and missions are coming. Send us your ideas from the Ideas tab on your phone!
What would you like to see in the game? Write your idea — every update adds the most requested ones.
e.g. Add a bus stop and a bus driver job…
Thank you! Your idea reached us.
No internet — saved, it will be sent when you're online.
Please wait a moment, you just sent one.
Your nickname, message and game version are saved anonymously to Firestore.
